transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—thanks for coming today. Can you tell me what brought you in to see me?

Hi, doctor. Thank you so much for fitting me in, I really appreciate it. 

Um... well, I guess what brought me in is... I've just been having a little trouble with my eating lately. It's probably not a huge deal, and I don't want to make a big fuss out of it, but I just hardly eat right anymore. Some days it's really just coffee and, I don't know, maybe a piece of bread. I just haven't had the appetite. And, well, I've noticed my pants are hanging pretty loose on me lately. 

I hope I'm explaining this right. Is that the kind of thing you needed to know?
Besides the changes in your eating, have you noticed feeling down, sad, or losing interest in things you normally enjoy?

Um... well... I guess, yeah, maybe a little bit. I really don't want to sound like I'm just complaining, because I know people have it a lot worse than me. But... most days, I just wake up with this... this heavy, empty feeling right in my chest. It just feels like nothing good is waiting for me out there, so I just want to keep my head down, you know? 

It's probably just me being foolish, honestly. Does that make sense? I hope it's okay that I'm telling you this, I just want to make sure I'm answering your questions right.
When you're eating less, is that because you're worried about your weight or how your body looks, or is it more that you just don't feel hungry or interested in food?

Oh, no, doctor... it's not about my weight or how I look at all. I really hope I didn't make it sound like I was being vain or obsessing over my appearance, I promise I'm not. I'm sorry if I gave you the wrong idea just now. 

It's really just... I just don't feel hungry. I'll look at food and my stomach just doesn't care. It almost feels like too much work to even try to eat, if that makes sense? The interest just isn't there right now. 

I hope that's an okay answer. I'm really trying my best to explain it right for you... is that what you were asking?
How long have you been feeling this way—the low mood and loss of appetite—has it been going on for a couple of weeks, or longer?

Um... well, it's... it's been a little while, I suppose. I really hope I'm not taking up too much of your time with all this, but... I think this whole spell has been hanging over me for about five months now. 

I know that sounds like a long time to just let things go, and I probably should have come in sooner. I just kept hoping it would pass and I wouldn't have to bother anyone about it. But yeah, about five months of just feeling this way. I hope that's the information you needed... am I giving you enough detail?

Over these past five months, how much has this low mood and low energy affected your ability to keep up with daily responsibilities, like work, chores, or seeing people—are there days you simply can't function, or have you mostly been able to push through?

Um... well... I guess I haven't been doing as well as I should be. I really don't want you to think I'm just being lazy, because I really do try to push through... I promise I do. But, um... lately it's just been so hard to keep up. 

I've actually... well, I've had to ask my relatives for a lot of help recently. More than I probably should. They've been helping me with money, and giving me rides places, and even helping me sort through my paperwork, because I just... I can't seem to focus on it. And my basic errands, like going to the store and things... I'm just not keeping up with them the way I used to. 

I feel terrible putting all that on my family, I really do. I should be able to handle these things myself. Does that make sense? I hope I'm explaining this right... I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right answers.
Have you had any thoughts of death, or thoughts that you'd be better off not being alive, during this time?

Oh, um... no, no, doctor. I wouldn't say that. I really don't want you to worry about me in that way, I promise. 

I mean... sure, sometimes I feel a bit useless, especially with how much my family has had to help me lately, and I feel bad about being a burden to them. But I haven't... I don't sit around wishing I was dead or anything like that. I really try to stay as positive as I can, considering everything. 

I hope that doesn't sound like I'm making light of it, because I know that's a very serious question you have to ask. But no, I haven't had thoughts like that. Is that... does that help clear things up for you?
On your hardest days recently, have there been times when you couldn't get out of bed, bathe, or take care of yourself at all, or have you always been able to manage at least the basics on your own?

Um... well, I really try my best to keep up with my hygiene, I promise. I know how important it is to stay clean and presentable, especially when I come to see you. I don't want to be a bother or, you know, be unpleasant to be around. 

But... I guess, if I'm being completely honest... it has been really, really hard lately. I don't want to sound like I'm just giving up, but sometimes my body just feels so heavy. It's like... like my arms and legs are filled with wet sand, you know? Just dragging. 

Even little things, like... like just taking the trash out, or even getting myself here to the clinic today... it takes everything I have. I feel so bad admitting that, because they're such small things. I should be able to do them easily. I hope you don't think less of me for struggling with it. I am trying, I really am. Am I making sense? I just want to be truthful with you so you can help me.
Have you noticed any unusual experiences lately, like hearing things others don't seem to hear, or having thoughts or beliefs that others might find hard to understand or believe?

Oh, no, definitely not. I haven't experienced anything like that. I really hope you don't think I'm... you know, losing touch with reality or anything. I know my mood has been really low and my energy is just terrible, but my mind is still clear in that way. 

I don't hear any voices or see things, and I don't have any strange ideas... I just feel really, really down and tired. I promise I'm being completely honest about that. I know you have to ask to make sure I'm safe and everything, which I really appreciate. But no, nothing unusual like that. Does that answer your question okay? I just want to make sure I'm giving you all the right information.

Over the past five months, have there been stretches where you were completely unable to go to work or manage on your own—needing someone else to handle things for you almost entirely—or have you generally still been able to get through the day, even if it's very hard?

Well, um... I always try to do as much as I can on my own. I really hate being a bother to anyone, you know? But... I guess if I'm looking back over these last few months, since things got really bad... I have needed a lot of help. 

I feel pretty ashamed to admit it, honestly. I've had to rely on my relatives for, well, almost everything. They've been helping me out with money, and giving me rides everywhere... and I just haven't been keeping up with my basic errands the way I used to. They even have had to help me sort out my paperwork and things like that, which I know I should be doing myself as a grown man. I just... I get so overwhelmed and I can't seem to figure it out right now. 

I really hope you don't think I'm just being lazy or taking advantage of them. I am trying so hard to get back to where I can handle it all again so they don't have to worry about me. Is it okay that I told you that? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right answers so you can help me.
